sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Real Estate anchor a narrow defensive-leaning market leadership, while cyclical sectors like Industrials and Basic Materials lose ground.

Energy continues to dominate the US sector landscape as the top momentum leader (0.92 momentum, Rank 1 YTD), anchoring a narrow group of just three "all-green" sectors alongside Real Estate and Consumer Defensive. Real Estate is showing notable strength, climbing 1 spot to Rank 3 with a strong 0.70 momentum score. 

Meanwhile, minor rotation is favoring Financials and Communication Services, which both improved their rankings by 1 spot over the last five sessions. Conversely, cyclical and industrial sectors are fading, with Basic Materials, Healthcare, and Industrials all slipping 1 spot. Consumer Cyclical remains anchored at the absolute bottom of the momentum pile (0.20 momentum, Rank 11 YTD).

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 3 out of 11 sector groups maintain "all-green" status, showing positive performance across all timeframes (weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD).
* **Energy Dominance:** Energy remains the undisputed leader, holding Rank 1 YTD with a momentum score of 0.92.
* **Real Estate & Defensive Anchor:** Real Estate (momentum 0.70, Rank 3) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.47, Rank 5) round out the all-green list, indicating a defensive bias in sustained strength.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Communication Services (+1 spot to Rank 9, momentum 0.45), Financials (+1 spot to Rank 7, momentum 0.63), and Real Estate (+1 spot to Rank 3, momentum 0.70) led the weekly rank improvements.
* **Top Losers:** Industrials (down 1 spot to Rank 4, momentum 0.35), Basic Materials (down 1 spot to Rank 8, momentum 0.22), and Healthcare (down 1 spot to Rank 10, momentum 0.52) fell furthest over the last 5 sessions.
* **Momentum Extremes:** Energy (0.917) and Real Estate (0.700) lead the momentum rankings, while Consumer Cyclical (0.200) and Basic Materials (0.217) remain the deepest laggards.

## Divergences
* **No Fragile All-Greens:** No fragile all-green divergences or rank mismatches are currently detected in the active leadership.
* **Healthcare Disconnect:** Healthcare presents a performance divergence, appearing as a top-five momentum leader (0.517) despite carrying a weak YTD rank of 10 and losing 1 rank spot this week.
* **Financials Lagging YTD Rank:** Financials show strong current momentum (0.633, ranking 4th overall) but continue to lag in overall YTD standing at Rank 7.

rotation_phase.label: Late Cycle
rotation_phase.reasoning: Energy and Real Estate are leading in momentum and breadth while Healthcare lags, which fits the Late Cycle profile of commodity-driven strength and lagging defensive growth.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** On July 20, 2026, Oil & Gas Refining and Healthcare REITs lead a highly selective market where only 23 of 144 groups are all-green, while Staffing and consumer retail rotate higher as Education and Aerospace sharply decline.

Market breadth remains narrow, with only 16% of industry groups (23 of 144) maintaining all-green status across all timeframes. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.99) and REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.91) continue to anchor the market's leadership, alongside Consumer Electronics and Staffing & Employment Services. Staffing is showing dual-engine strength, ranking as both a top momentum leader (0.87) and a major weekly gainer, jumping 18 spots to rank 12.

Meanwhile, rotation is evident as consumer-oriented groups like Apparel Retail (+15 spots), Tobacco (+15 spots), and Leisure (+13 spots) climb the ranks. Conversely, we see sharp fading in Education & Training Services (-32 spots), Aluminum (-25 spots), and Aerospace & Defense (-22 spots), which have suffered the steepest weekly declines. Uranium (momentum 0.12) and Information Technology Services (momentum 0.03) remain deeply entrenched as momentum laggards.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 23 of 144 industry groups are currently all-green across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD horizons.
* **Sustained Leaders:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.99, YTD rank 2) and REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.91, YTD rank 23) lead the sustained strong performers alongside Consumer Electronics and Staffing & Employment Services.
* **All-Green Cohort:** Other resilient all-green industries include REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.88), Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.86), Trucking (momentum 0.86), and Railroads (momentum 0.85).

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Shell Companies (+25 spots to rank 72, momentum 0.43) and Staffing & Employment Services (+18 spots to rank 12, momentum 0.87) experienced the strongest five-session improvements, followed by Apparel Retail (+15 spots) and Tobacco (+15 spots).
* **Top Losers:** Education & Training Services plummeted 32 spots to rank 98, followed by Aluminum (-25 spots to rank 95) and Aerospace & Defense (-22 spots to rank 108).
* **Momentum Extremes:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.990) and REIT - Healthcare Facilities (0.915) hold the highest momentum scores, while Information Technology Services (0.030) and Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.132) sit at the absolute bottom of the YTD rankings.

## Divergences
* **Fading Strength:** Several high-momentum industries are losing ground, led by Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.74, -6 spots), Publishing (momentum 0.67, -7 spots), and Biotechnology (momentum 0.63, -4 spots).
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Low-momentum groups are quietly climbing, with Shell Companies (+25 spots, momentum 0.43), Specialty Business Services (+9 spots, momentum 0.48), and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+7 spots, momentum 0.50) showing early signs of accumulation.
